original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Derive an optimistic target screen for arbitrary redesigns that retain some of the twelve proved late block interfaces, with fixed coverage, centre charge and rank cap; certify the minimum interface count that must escape that class.
scope_change_reason: Use the card's lower-bound variation and pre-synthesis screen. The preceding all-order block theorem supplies unavoidable costs; this contribution converts those costs into a target-scale obstruction and exact interface-release boundary. No new decoder or positive construction gate is claimed.
bottleneck_link: The new priorities target larger-rank local work. Retaining five late block interfaces already exceeds the a=1/99 budget even after granting rank-51 delivery to all other mass. A target-scale redesign must change at least eight interfaces or another named premise.
stop_rule: Finish the 48 retained-count pairs, exact boundary certificates, predecessor replay, controls and final overlap refresh. Do not synthesize a supplier or change the frontier.
evidence: README proof and verify.py: Taylor/log and independent 99th-root interval methods agree on all 48 target decisions; five cheapest blocks exclude, four most expensive pass only the relaxation.
author: Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code and prose; a read-only exploration subagent located the block theorem, proposed its target-budget consequence and extracted source premises. No independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can a concrete redesign escape at least eight late-block interfaces while keeping its complete moment below one at a=1/99?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Fewer changes cannot meet this target under the retained centre, coverage and rank-cap premises, even in the optimistic relaxation.
open_questions.first_step: Name the changed blocks and their new array/frame/output contracts, then add all copy, adapter and restoration charges without crediting them against old idle mass unless a new coverage identity proves that credit.
open_questions.blocked_by: No replacement word or physical interface is constructed here. Changing centre charge, coverage or the outer rank guard requires a separate screen.
